native_sdk_note: Recommended onboarding starts with the OpenAI-compatible API. When you need native Igris features, the first-class SDKs are JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, and Rust. Python remains preview. Java, C#, and Ruby should use an OpenAI-compatible client today.
